reference.features: CIMSS IR temperatures, Raw T (not Final T/CI), IR structural radius and strictly causal six-hour IR history
reference.labels: IBTrACS USA 1-minute best-track wind/pressure; interpolation across gaps ≤6 h

scope: Regular-eye Atlantic/Eastern Pacific archive-measurement benchmark, not independent recon verification. Native sampling differences remain.

wind.selection: 2023 MAE + 0.35 × MAE for reference winds ≥130 kt; optional bias fit on 2022 only

pressure.selection: 2023 MAE + 0.35 × MAE for reference winds ≥130 kt; optional bias fit on 2022 only
